event.title: Brazil Holds Presidential Runoff Between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro
event.canonical_title: Brazil Holds Presidential Runoff Between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro
event.summary: Brazilians are voting in a closely contested presidential runoff between incumbent leftist President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. This election is seen as pivotal, with implications for Brazil's political direction and US influence in Latin America. The campaign has been marked by allegations of corruption and economic challenges.

timeline.title: Brazil Holds Presidential Runoff Between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro
timeline.summary: Brazilians participated in a decisive presidential runoff election, choosing between leftist candidate Lula and right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. Voter turnout was marked by long queues in urban areas and unique journeys, such as canoe trips in the Amazon. The election outcome will significantly influence Brazil's political direction.
key_facts: Presidential runoff election held in Brazil
